title: Models with organization links must update IDOR Semgrep rules
answers: Why is check-idor-model-coverage.py failing when adding a new model?
What security checks must be updated when creating an organization-linked model?
Where do new models linked to Organization need to be registered for IDOR coverage?
body:
When adding a model with an organization link, it must be added to .semgrep/rules/security/idor-team-scoped-models.yaml.
Both organization-scoped rules in that file must include the new model name in their model patterns.
If omitted, check-idor-model-coverage.py fails in CI because all models with an organization link require IDOR coverage.
Reference: products/feature_flags/backend/models/organization_feature_flags_config.py:OrganizationFeatureFlagsConfig and .semgrep/rules/security/idor-team-scoped-models.yaml.
applies: Adding any new Django model with an organization or team link
says: Continuous integration security scans fail after introducing a new organization setting
Automated pull request checks flag missing tenant access control on new data
Security test fails because our new organization record lacks authorization inspection rules
Register new organization settings to pass automated cross tenant security checks
